title: 第1章 跑车遭惊雷 坠崖入异世第2章 浅滩生火起 相依觅海鲜
lines: 青央市近郊的半山别墅区，林木葱郁，环境清幽。罗止正家的独栋别墅隐在山间，气派阔绰，处处透着寻常人家难以企及的奢华。
清晨的阳光斜斜洒进卧室，罗止正才慢悠悠从床上醒来。
他今年二十岁，身高一米八五，肩宽腰窄，身形挺拔。刚从部队退伍没多久，一身冷硬沉稳的气质。他起身换上一件黑色polo衫，搭配黑色牛仔裤，脚上踩着一双黑色帆布鞋，从头到脚一身素黑，简单利落，气场十足。
洗漱下楼，宽敞精致的客厅里，父母早已坐在一旁。
母亲眉头微蹙，面露担忧，柔声劝道：“你天天在家待着，不是睡觉就是发呆，总不是长久之计。”
父亲跟着点头，神色严肃，沉声道：“出去体验体验生活，找点事做。你那辆黄色跑车闲着也是闲着，开出去跑跑单，接触接触人也好。”
罗止正心里无奈。
谁都知道他是含着金汤匙出生的富二代，家境优渥，从小锦衣玉食。可没人知道，他心底藏着一个荒唐又隐秘的梦想——他不想接手家族生意，不想应付复杂的人情世故，更不想被钱和身份束缚，只想当一个无拘无束、自由自在的乞丐。
这个念头他连父母都不敢说，只能藏在心底。如今被家人这么一催，他也懒得反驳，索性拿出手机，下载了打车软件，随手注册账号，权当应付了事。
他本以为要等很久，没想到刚注册完毕，系统立刻派来一单。
起点：青央公园。
终点：飞龙山望月台。
罗止正起身走向车库。
偌大的车库里停着多辆名车，最惹眼的便是那辆亮黄色限量超跑，车身线条凌厉，车漆耀眼，一看便价值不菲。他拉开车门坐进驾驶座，发动引擎，低沉浑厚的声浪响起，车子平稳驶出别墅，朝着青央公园而去。
抵达约定地点，他一眼便看见了站在路边的女孩。
李紫云，十八岁，大一学生，身高一米七，身形高挑修长，气质干净柔和。她穿着一件浅色系简约短袖t恤，搭配浅色休闲长裤，脚上一双小白鞋，长发轻垂，清爽又自然，在人群中格外显眼。
看到一辆如此惹眼的跑车停在面前，她明显愣了一下，才带着几分拘谨走上前。
李紫云指尖微攥，怯生生地小声开口：“师傅……是去飞龙山望月台的吗？”
罗止正淡淡瞥她一眼，面色冷肃，语气平淡道：“是，上车吧。”
李紫云轻轻应了一声，拉开车门坐进副驾，低头系好安全带。车内奢华的内饰与她朴素的穿着形成反差，让她有些不自在，双手安静放在腿上，显得格外乖巧。
车子沿着蜿蜒山路向上行驶，一侧是陡峭岩壁，草木丛生；另一侧是深不见底的悬崖，绿意浓重。越往上，山风越凉，天色也迅速暗沉下来。乌云层层压顶，空气沉闷得几乎让人窒息，一场暴雨仿佛随时都会倾盆而下。
车厢内一片安静。
罗止正专注看着前路，侧脸线条冷硬利落。李紫云偷偷抬眼瞄了他一下，又飞快低下头，心里不由得有些紧张。这个司机长相出众，气质清冷，让人不敢多看，却又忍不住在意。
李紫云望着窗外暗沉的天色，眉眼微蹙，轻声开口：“好像……要下雨了。”
罗止正刚轻轻点了下头，视线还落在前方蜿蜒的山路上，下一秒——
一道刺眼白光猛然划破天际，惊天动地的惊雷竟精准地劈在了前方不远处的路面上！碎石飞溅，烟尘四起，坚硬的山路当场被劈出一道深不见底的沟壑！
罗止正脸色骤变，神色慌乱，急声大喝：“糟了！”
刻在骨子里的军人素养让他在零点一秒内做出反应。他猛踩刹车，轮胎与地面剧烈摩擦，发出刺耳的尖叫。可距离实在太近，上山车速又不慢，黄色跑车根本来不及停下，带着巨大的惯性，直接冲破了摇摇欲坠的山路护栏！
失重感瞬间席卷全身。
“啊——！”李紫云吓得浑身发软，大脑一片空白，尖叫声卡在喉咙里，只发出微弱的气音。她整个人僵在座位上，手脚冰凉，脑子里只有一个绝望的念头：这次死定了。
她下意识闭上眼，手指死死攥住裤腿，脸色惨白如纸。罗止正余光瞥见她害怕到发抖的模样，心头猛地一紧，想伸手护住她，可身体早已被惯性甩得失控。车子呼啸着坠向黑暗深渊，狂风在耳边疯狂呼啸，世界在眼前飞速颠倒，恐惧像潮水一样将两人淹没。
就在两人都以为必死无疑的刹那——深渊底部，毫无征兆地，突然出现一道诡异而耀眼的蓝色漩涡！漩涡旋转不休，泛着幽幽冷光，像是一只睁开的巨眼，一股无法抗拒的强大吸力猛地一卷！连人带车，毫无反抗之力，直接被那道漩涡狠狠吞了进去！
content_en:
The mid-level villa area on the outskirts of Qingyang City has lush trees and a quiet environment. The single-family villa of Luo Zhizheng's family is hidden in the mountains. It is magnificent and full of luxury that ordinary people cannot match.
The early morning sunlight slanted into the bedroom, and Luo Zhizheng slowly woke up from the bed.
He is twenty years old, 1.85 meters tall, with broad shoulders and narrow waist, and a tall and straight figure. He had just retired from the army and had a cold and calm temperament. He stood up and put on a black polo shirt, paired with black jeans, and a pair of black canvas shoes. He was dressed in plain black from head to toe, simple, neat, and full of aura.
After washing up and going downstairs, my parents were already sitting in the spacious and exquisite living room.
The mother frowned slightly, with a worried look on her face, and advised softly: "It's not a long-term solution for you to stay at home every day, either sleeping or in a daze."
The father nodded, with a serious look on his face, and said in a deep voice: "Go out and experience life, and find something to do. Your yellow sports car is just idle. It's good to drive it out to run orders and meet people."
Luo Zhizheng felt helpless.
Everyone knows that he is a second-generation rich man who was born with a silver spoon in his mouth. His family is well-off and he has been well clothed and well-fed since he was a child. But no one knows that he has a ridiculous and secret dream hidden in his heart - he doesn't want to take over the family business, he doesn't want to deal with the complicated world, and he doesn't want to be bound by money and status. He just wants to be an unrestrained and free beggar.
He didn't even dare to tell his parents about this idea, so he could only hide it in his heart. Now being urged by his family, he didn't bother to refute. He simply took out his mobile phone, downloaded the taxi app, registered an account and took care of it.
He thought he would have to wait for a long time, but he didn't expect that the system would send an order as soon as the registration was completed.
Starting point: Qingyang Park.
End point: Feilong Mountain Viewing Platform.
Luo Zhizheng stood up and walked to the garage.
There are many famous cars parked in the huge garage. The most eye-catching one is the bright yellow limited edition supercar. It has sharp body lines and dazzling paint. It is worth a lot at first glance. He opened the door and got into the driver's seat, started the engine, a deep and deep sound sounded, and the car smoothly drove out of the villa and headed towards Qingyang Park.
When he arrived at the agreed place, he immediately saw the girl standing on the roadside.
Li Ziyun, 18 years old, a freshman, 1.7 meters tall, tall and slender, with a clean and gentle temperament. She wore a light-colored simple short-sleeved T-shirt, paired with light-colored casual trousers, and a pair of white shoes. Her long hair hung lightly, refreshing and natural, and she stood out among the crowd.
Seeing such an eye-catching sports car parked in front of her, she was visibly stunned for a moment before stepping forward with some restraint.
Li Ziyun clenched her fingertips slightly and timidly whispered: "Master...are you going to Feilong Mountain to watch the moon?"
Luo Zhizheng glanced at her lightly, with a cold face and said calmly: "Yes, get in the car."
Li Ziyun responded softly, opened the door and got into the passenger seat, lowered his head and fastened his seat belt. The contrast between the luxurious interior of the car and her simple clothes made her feel a little uncomfortable. She placed her hands quietly on her lap, looking particularly well-behaved.
The car drove up the winding mountain road. On one side was a steep rock wall with thick vegetation; on the other side was a bottomless cliff with thick greenery. The higher you go up, the cooler the mountain breeze becomes, and the sky becomes darker quickly. Dark clouds were looming overhead, the air was so heavy that it was almost suffocating, and a heavy rain seemed likely to pour down at any moment.
There was silence in the carriage.
Luo Zhi was looking intently at the road ahead, his profile profile cold and sharp. Li Ziyun secretly raised her eyes to glance at him, then quickly lowered her head, feeling a little nervous. This driver has an outstanding appearance and a cold temperament. People dare not look at him more, but they can't help but care about him.
Li Ziyun looked at the dark sky outside the window, frowned slightly, and said softly: "It seems... it's going to rain."
Luo Zhizheng just nodded slightly, his eyes still falling on the winding mountain road ahead, the next second——
Click——! !
A dazzling white light suddenly pierced the sky, and earth-shaking thunder struck the road not far ahead with precision! Rubbles flew everywhere, smoke and dust flew everywhere, and a bottomless ravine was carved out of the hard mountain road on the spot!
Luo Zhizheng's face suddenly changed, he looked panicked, and he shouted urgently: "Oops!"
The military quality engraved in his bones allowed him to react within a tenth of a second. He slammed on the brakes, causing the tires to squeal violently against the ground. But the distance was too close, and the speed of the car going up the mountain was not slow. The yellow sports car had no time to stop, and with its huge inertia, it directly broke through the shaky mountain road guardrail!
The feeling of weightlessness swept through my body instantly.
"Ah——!" Li Ziyun was so frightened that his whole body went limp, his mind went blank, his scream was stuck in his throat, and he only made a weak breath sound. She was frozen in her seat, her hands and feet were cold, and there was only one desperate thought in her mind: She was dead this time.
She closed her eyes subconsciously, clutched her trouser legs with her fingers, and her face was as pale as paper. Luo Zhizheng caught a glimpse of her trembling with fear from the corner of his eye, and his heart tightened suddenly. He wanted to reach out to protect her, but his body had already been thrown out of control by the inertia. The car roared and fell into the dark abyss, the wind roared crazily in the ears, the world quickly turned upside down in front of their eyes, and fear drowned the two of them like a tide.
At the moment when both of them thought they were certain to die - at the bottom of the abyss, without warning, a strange and dazzling blue vortex suddenly appeared! The vortex rotates endlessly, glowing with a faint cold light, like a giant eye that opens, and an irresistible and powerful suction force suddenly rolls up! The man and the car were all swallowed up by the whirlpool without any resistance!
title_en: Chapter 1: The sports car was struck by thunder and fell off a cliff into another world Chapter 2: A fire was lit in the shallows and we were looking for seafood together
